failing_checks.title: Cumulative budget
failing_checks.reason: The only cumulative control is the per-call maximum. No code sums deposits per account, per day or per caller, and the Stellar payment path in tasks.py:87-95 has no budget check. Many small requests can each pass the cap and trigger separate anchor payments.
